Marriage Licenses
The Ohio County Clerk’s Office Does Not Perform Marriage Ceremonies
It is VERY helpful and saves a lot of time in the office if you start your application online.
It can then be completed in the office. https://www.in.gov/judiciary/2605.htm
Please see website for what you need to bring when applying.
-For Indiana residents, at least one applicant must reside in Ohio County.
-Applicants that reside in a different Indiana County may not apply in Ohio County.
-Out-of-state residents may apply for a marriage license in Ohio County ONLY if the ceremony is
performed in Ohio County.
Hours:
Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday 8:30 – 3:30
Cost:
Indiana Residents: $25.00 (+$2.00 per certified copy)
Out-of-state Residents: $65.00 (+$2.00 per certified copy)
We accept CASH, CREDIT CARDS or MONEY ORDERS
Please call if you have any questions. (812) 438-2610

Circuit Court
If you have any questions regarding language access for Court proceedings, please contact the Ohio Circuit Court
at (812) 438-3410.
The Circuit Court serves Ohio and Dearborn Counties under Judge F. Aaron Negangard and Magistrate Jerome J. Charles . The Ohio Circuit Court is located on the second floor of the historic Ohio County Courthouse, 413 Main Street, Rising Sun, IN 47040
Court Hours & Holiday Schedule
Jury Duty
We want to thank potential jurors for their service. Our government is one “by the people” and “for the people” and the participation of our community members in this most important duty is very appreciated.
Serving on a jury is one of our most important civic duties and most jurors find the experience to be a very interesting and rewarding one.
The right to trial by jury is fundamental to our system of justice. Those who are called to serve on jury duty have a very important role. Your service is deeply appreciated and we have included the following information for your assistance.
